system.abilityText:
Once per scene, declare an automatic success on a single leap: cross a gap in a straight line up to your Speed in squares, no roll, landing exactly where you meant to.

It does not make you land quietly. That is a separate problem, and it is now yours.
system.blurb: Jumping Spiders are the acrobats of the underworld, and they know it, and they will bring it up. They look like someone glued oversized eyes to a scrap of carpet, which is exactly why humans who spot them say “aww” instead of reaching for a shoe. That reaction lasts about four seconds. Use them well.
